name: SignatureOnlyAccount
signed_authorization: agent, nonce, validUntil; chain/account in personal-sign digest
limitations: No target, calldata, value or outcome commitment; target failure reverts nonce.

name: SpendLimitGuardAccount
signed_authorization: agent, token, maximum, nonce, validUntil; chain/account in personal-sign digest
limitations: Recipient not signed; raw transfer true checked; no post-state. Token false return shares SpendExceeded classification.

name: PathAndSpendGuardAccount
signed_authorization: agent, target, selector, maximum, nonce, validUntil; chain/account in personal-sign digest
limitations: First address argument not signed. No value parameter or batch; selector is signed, not hardcoded to transfer.

name: CresnexIntentLockAccountV2
signed_authorization: Complete EIP-712 manifest; ordered calls and policy
workload_applicability: V2 fixed policy modules and ordered calls
limitations: Listed outcome constraints only; successful outer receipt may contain rejected inner execution.

name: SemanticGuardAccount
limitations: No implemented semantic baseline. A fair shared method specification and workload scope are unresolved; no substitute results.
